name: Mason Jar Chicken "Zoodle" Soup with Mixed Veggies (Prep-Ahead)

ingredients.name: frozen mixed vegetables (carrots, corn, green beans, peas)
rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat

instructions.primary_message: Divide chicken bouillon cubes and soy sauce between two (quart-sized) jars. (Make sure to add the correct amount of bouillon; each jar should have enough to make 3 cups of broth.)
Wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the jars with the bouillon.
Add frozen veggies to the jars.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 cups frozen mixed vegetables (carrots, corn, green beans, peas)

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and trim zucchini; use a julienne (or regular) peeler to make noodles. Add to the jars.
Place chicken on the cutting board and, using your hands, remove meat from the skin and bones; separate the meat into shred-like pieces. Add to the jars.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ (532 g) whole chicken rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat

instructions.primary_message: Screw lids onto jars and store in the fridge until needed. (Best if used within 2-3 days.)

When ready to eat, empty jar into a microwave safe bowl. Fill now-empty jar ⅔ full with water and add to the bowl. Microwave on high until veggies and chicken are warmed through, about 6 minutes. Let sit for 1 minute, then carefully remove from the microwave. (Alternatively, place jar contents and water in a medium saucepan, then stir to combine. Bring to a simmer over medium-high and cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are soft, 3-4 minutes.) Enjoy!
